class.name: EditorAction
class.experimental: This editor UI component may change as more editor screens adopt it.
class.brief_description: A shared description and state model for an editor command.
class.description: [EditorAction] separates command state from its visual presentation. The same action can be presented by an [EditorActionButton], an [EditorToolbar], or another editor surface while sharing its text, icon, shortcut, enabled state, checked state, and callback. Actions describe user intent only. The callback's owner remains responsible for changing document state and using undo/redo where appropriate.

method.name: trigger
method.description: Invokes the action when it is enabled and visible. Checkable actions toggle [member checked] before emitting [signal triggered] and invoking [member callback].

members.member: Stable semantic identifier for the action.
Whether triggering the action toggles [member checked].
Current checked state for a checkable action.
Whether the action can be triggered.
Name of an icon in the editor theme. Presentations resolve the texture when their theme changes.
Optional keyboard shortcut associated with the action.
Detailed description shown by visual presentations.
Whether visual presentations of the action are visible.

signal.name: triggered
signal.description: Emitted when the action successfully triggers.
